user.title: Astrophotography sensors and lights
user.description: Pick outdoor temperature and humidity sensors to average. Blocked lights stay off during Astrophotography Mode. Dimmed lights are capped at the max brightness. Actuators (dew heaters, 12V relays, outlets) can turn on or off when dew risk becomes Unsafe, Safe, or both by putting them in multiple lists.

data.blocked_lights: Lights to keep off in Astro Mode
data.dimmed_lights: Lights to dim in Astro Mode

behavior.title: Dew risk and brightness
behavior.description: Dew margin uses {unit}. Unsafe when outdoor air is within this many degrees of the dew point. Hysteresis stops the Safe/Unsafe edge from chattering. Max brightness caps dimmed lights while Astrophotography Mode is on.

data.dew_margin_c: Unsafe when dew margin is at or below
data.hysteresis_c: Extra margin required before returning to Safe

error.threshold_positive: Dew margin and hysteresis have to be greater than zero.
